svg.title: Security admin rules come before the NSG
svg.desc: Inbound traffic to a spoke VM meets sac-lab's rules first. SSH from the hub's /20 matches the AlwaysAllow rule at priority 90 and is let in, so the NSG's deny of the same traffic is never read; SSH from the Internet service tag matches the Deny rule at priority 100 and is refused whatever the NSG says. Only traffic neither rule matches goes on to the spoke's NSG.
